title: Which technical record names assure.CodeFaults, the one function the gates call for the code-standard faults?
description: CodeFaults in internal/assure/code_standard.go runs the six predicates ST-ASR-SP05-PR to ST-ASR-SP10-PR over the tree and the spec at a commit and returns their faults in order. The gate handlers ST-ASR-CMD02-H and ST-ASR-CMD03-H will call it for ST-ASR-UC02-R05 and ST-ASR-UC03-R04. No record names it: a predicate record has no description in which to name it, and no domain service exists for it, so a service record is wrong. Options: add a domain service, such as Find the code faults, with its service record assure.CodeFaults; let the descriptions of the gate handlers name it; or accept that a function which only joins the predicates of records needs no record of its own.
